basis: renders a bare <div> — column geometry only, no semantics of its own.

responsive.basis: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, minTileWidth), 1fr)) recomputes the column count from the container width; the gap scale steps at Tailwind's sm.

interaction.basis: a pure grid wrapper — nothing operates.

exceptions.because: no inertness pin yet — nothing in it operates or takes focus by design, and the browserless tier does not yet prove the absence
